title: This 5-Foot Bird Beheads Baby Crocodiles With One Strike

scenes.text: It's a shoebill, five feet tall, with a bill about a foot long.
It stands frozen like a statue, waiting for something to swim by.
Then it lunges, bill wide open, and scoops up the prey with a mouthful of mud.
The sharp edges of that bill cut off the head before it swallows. Lungfish, snakes, baby crocodiles.
A bird that beheads crocodiles. Now watch it again.

description:
This bird beheads baby crocodiles. The shoebill is about five feet tall with a bill roughly a foot long.
It waits motionless in African swamps, then lunges and uses its sharp bill edges to behead its catch.
Would you walk through a swamp with one nearby?
first_comment: Which animal would you least want to meet in a swamp?
